segments.text: After you have completed your initial decontamination, preparation, and checks of the BSC, you can
segments.zh: 完成生物安全柜的初始去污、准备和检查之后，你就可以

segments.text: begin work.
segments.zh: 开始工作了。

segments.text: Remember to wear PPE appropriate for the work you will perform.
segments.zh: 记住要穿戴适合你所要进行的工作的个人防护装备。

segments.text: Some groups require that you line your immediate work area with absorbent plastic back material
segments.zh: 有些团队要求在你的直接工作区域铺上带塑料背衬的吸水材料，

segments.text: to prevent contamination of the work's surface and facilitate cleanup.
segments.zh: 以防止工作台面被污染，并便于清理。

segments.text: That practice is determined by a risk assessment and SOPs, but do not allow this material
segments.zh: 这种做法由风险评估和 SOP 决定，但不要让这种材料

segments.text: to block the front or rear air grills.
segments.zh: 遮挡前格栅或后格栅。

segments.text: Before loading the BSC, it is a good practice to wipe the external surfaces of all needed
segments.zh: 在往生物安全柜里放东西之前，最好先用消毒剂擦拭所有所需物品的

segments.text: supplies with disinfectant to reduce the introduction of outside contaminants into the cabinet.
segments.zh: 外表面，以减少把外部污染物带入柜内。

segments.text: It is recommended to load necessary materials once in the beginning to minimize your arms
segments.zh: 建议一开始就把所需材料一次性放进去，尽量减少工作时手臂

segments.text: entering and exiting while working.
segments.zh: 进进出出。

segments.text: Don't forget a biohazardous waste container, sharps container, paper towels, or wipes.
segments.zh: 别忘了生物危害废物容器、锐器盒、纸巾或擦拭巾。

segments.text: Please note, large autoclave pans should only be used in 6-foot or larger BSCs.
segments.zh: 请注意，大型高压灭菌盘只能在 6 英尺或更大的生物安全柜中使用。

segments.text: For smaller BSCs, alternative biohazardous waste containers or bag stands should be used.
segments.zh: 较小的生物安全柜应使用其他的生物危害废物容器或垃圾袋支架。

segments.text: Remember the clean to dirty principle and place clean materials on one side of the
segments.zh: 记住从洁到污的原则，把干净的材料放在

segments.text: BSC and the biological waste and sharps container on the opposite or dirty side.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜的一侧，把生物废物和锐器盒放在另一侧，也就是污染侧。

segments.text: In this video, we are demonstrating placement of materials for a right-handed person.
segments.zh: 在本视频中，我们演示的是惯用右手者的材料摆放方式。

segments.text: Materials would be reversed for a left-handed person.
segments.zh: 对于惯用左手者，材料摆放应左右对调。

segments.text: Remember to keep the front and rear grills unobstructed to avoid disrupting the airflow
segments.zh: 记住保持前格栅和后格栅畅通，以免扰乱生物安全柜内的

segments.text: in the BSC.
segments.zh: 气流。

segments.text: Items should be placed as far back in the cabinet as possible without blocking the rear
segments.zh: 物品应尽量放在柜内靠后的位置，但不要挡住后

segments.text: grill.
segments.zh: 格栅。

segments.text: While working in a BSC, you should be seated and only one person should work in the BSC
segments.zh: 在生物安全柜中工作时，你应该坐着，而且同一时间只能有一个人

segments.text: at a time.
segments.zh: 在生物安全柜中工作。

segments.text: If two people need to work in the BSC at the same time, the BSC must be a minimum of
segments.zh: 如果需要两个人同时在生物安全柜中工作，生物安全柜的宽度必须至少为

segments.text: 6 feet wide in length and a risk assessment must be performed and documented.
segments.zh: 6 英尺，并且必须进行风险评估并形成书面记录。

segments.text: Sit down at the BSC and adjust the height of the chair so your face is above the opening
segments.zh: 在生物安全柜前坐下，调整椅子高度，使你的脸位于开口上方、

segments.text: and behind the glass.
segments.zh: 玻璃后面。

segments.text: Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle at the elbow while inside the BSC.
segments.zh: 手臂在生物安全柜内时，肘部应弯曲成 90 度。

segments.text: Some BSCs are designed to allow your arms to rest on the front part of the BSC to avoid
segments.zh: 有些生物安全柜的设计允许你把手臂搁在安全柜前部，以避免

segments.text: fatigue or ergonomic injuries over time.
segments.zh: 长时间工作造成疲劳或人体工学损伤。

segments.text: Older BSCs that do not have a built-in armrest can be supplemented with a separate armrest
segments.zh: 没有内置扶手的老式生物安全柜，可以另外配一个单独的扶手，

segments.text: that is designed to be placed on the BSC front opening or is attached to the front
segments.zh: 这种扶手设计为放在生物安全柜前开口处，或者安装在前

segments.text: grill.
segments.zh: 格栅上。

segments.text: If used, the BSC should be certified with them in place.
segments.zh: 如果使用扶手，生物安全柜应在装有扶手的状态下进行认证。

segments.text: Use a foot support if your legs do not reach the floor or if needed for back comfort.
segments.zh: 如果你的脚够不着地面，或者为了背部舒适，可以使用脚踏。

segments.text: Minimize entering and exiting the BSC.
segments.zh: 尽量减少手臂进出生物安全柜。

segments.text: If you need to exit and enter the BSC, pull your arms straight out and insert your arms
segments.zh: 如果需要把手臂移出和伸入生物安全柜，要把手臂笔直地抽出，再笔直地

segments.text: straight in.
segments.zh: 伸入，

segments.text: Perpendicular to the opening, this will minimize air being pulled out of the cabinet
segments.zh: 与开口保持垂直，这样可以尽量减少空气被拉出柜外，

segments.text: and into the breathing zone of the person sitting at the BSC.
segments.zh: 进入坐在生物安全柜前的人的呼吸区。

segments.text: This is illustrated with a smoke machine in the Factors Affecting BSC Airflow video.
segments.zh: 这一点在《影响生物安全柜气流的因素》视频中用烟雾机做了演示。

segments.text: Please note, some laboratory SOPs may require you to remove your contaminated gloves and
segments.zh: 请注意，有些实验室的 SOP 可能要求你在手臂移出生物安全柜之前，摘下被污染的手套，

segments.text: place them in the biohazard container prior to exiting the BSC and put on a new pair
segments.zh: 放进生物危害容器，并在再次伸入之前戴上一副新

segments.text: of gloves before re-entry.
segments.zh: 手套。

segments.text: Be sure to protect the vacuum line.
segments.zh: 一定要保护好真空管路。

segments.text: This must include using a HEPA filter and capping unused lines.
segments.zh: 这必须包括使用 HEPA 过滤器，并把不用的管路封堵起来。
